newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 492 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 492 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totalled 492 contracts compared with 407 overnight Sunday, according to the CBOT.
There were 12 wheat, 225 corn, 228 soybean, two soymeal, 16 soyoil, one rice, two soybean call and six soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was steady to 1/4 cent higher, corn was 1/4 lower to 1/2 higher and soybeans were 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 cents higher.
